quickAnswer.en: In 2026, brand Janumet (50 mg/500 mg or 50 mg/1000 mg tablets) carries a list price of approximately $527 per 30-day supply. Generic sitagliptin/metformin tablets began entering US pharmacies in May 2026 under patent settlement agreements, with GoodRx coupon prices starting around $110 per month. Medicare Part D covers Janumet under the standard formulary tier with no drug-specific monthly cap; the 2026 annual Part D out-of-pocket cap of $2,000 applies. Uninsured patients who cannot afford the drug may qualify for free Janumet through the Merck Helps patient assistance program at 400 percent of the federal poverty level. Medicaid covers sitagliptin/metformin combinations with a $1 to $4 copay in most states.

introParagraphs.en: Janumet is Merck's fixed-dose combination tablet of sitagliptin (a DPP-4 inhibitor) and metformin hydrochloride (a biguanide), prescribed together for adults with type 2 diabetes when both active ingredients are clinically appropriate. Merck markets two forms: Janumet (immediate-release, taken twice daily with meals) and Janumet XR (extended-release, taken once daily). The drug combines the blood-sugar-lowering mechanisms of sitagliptin, which prolongs the action of incretin hormones after meals, with metformin, which reduces hepatic glucose output and improves insulin sensitivity. Januvia contains sitagliptin alone. Janumet packages that same ingredient alongside metformin for patients already on both drugs or those for whom combination tablet adherence is preferred.
introParagraphs.es: Janumet es el comprimido de combinacion de dosis fija de Merck de sitagliptina (un inhibidor DPP-4) y clorhidrato de metformina (una biguanida), recetado en conjunto para adultos con diabetes tipo 2 cuando ambos principios activos son clinicamente apropiados. Merck comercializa dos formas: Janumet (liberacion inmediata, tomado dos veces al dia con las comidas) y Janumet XR (liberacion prolongada, tomado una vez al dia). El medicamento combina los mecanismos reductores de glucosa en sangre de la sitagliptina, que prolonga la accion de las hormonas incretinas despues de las comidas, con la metformina, que reduce la produccion hepatica de glucosa y mejora la sensibilidad a la insulina.

introParagraphs.en: Janumet's list price reached roughly $527 per month by 2026, compared to the ingredient cost of metformin alone at under $15 per month. The combination premium reflects Merck's pricing of the sitagliptin component, not the metformin. Two simultaneous forces are pushing Janumet costs down in 2026 and 2027: the arrival of generic sitagliptin/metformin tablets under patent settlement agreements effective May 2026, and the Inflation Reduction Act Round 2 negotiation that set a Maximum Fair Price of $80 per month for Janumet through Medicare Part D, effective January 1, 2027. That 85 percent reduction from the 2024 list price is the largest percentage cut among all 15 Round 2 IRA-negotiated drugs. For context, Janumet's companion molecule Januvia received a 79 percent IRA Round 1 reduction effective January 2026, bringing its Medicare price to $113 per month. Patients enrolled in Medicare Part D who are waiting for the January 2027 Janumet Maximum Fair Price should confirm their plan's current 2026 formulary tier and copay for the drug.
introParagraphs.es: El precio de lista de Janumet alcanzo aproximadamente $527 por mes en 2026, comparado con el costo del ingrediente metformina sola en menos de $15 por mes. La prima de combinacion refleja el precio de Merck del componente de sitagliptina, no la metformina. Dos fuerzas simultaneas estan reduciendo los costos de Janumet en 2026 y 2027: la llegada de comprimidos genericos de sitagliptina/metformina bajo acuerdos de resolucion de patentes efectivos en mayo de 2026, y la negociacion de la Ronda 2 de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion que fijo un Precio Maximo Justo de $80 por mes para Janumet a traves de Medicare Parte D, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2027.

introParagraphs.en: Patients with Medicare Part D who need both sitagliptin and metformin should also ask their prescriber whether the combination tablet offers any clinical advantage over taking generic sitagliptin (already at the $113 IRA Round 1 Maximum Fair Price since January 2026) alongside generic metformin (under $15 per month at retail). Splitting the drugs may cost less in 2026 than using Janumet before the 2027 Round 2 price takes effect. This page covers 2026 pricing for brand Janumet and generic sitagliptin/metformin by pharmacy, the Merck Helps patient assistance program with an income eligibility table based on the 2026 [federal poverty level](/en/federal-poverty-level), Medicare Part D coverage details, and what Medicaid and commercially insured patients can expect to pay. Patients who qualify for [Medicaid](/en/medicaid-income-limits) typically pay $1 to $4 per prescription for the combination. Related pages: [Januvia cost](/en/drug/januvia-cost) covers the single-ingredient sitagliptin; [metformin cost](/en/drug/metformin-cost) covers the stand-alone biguanide.
introParagraphs.es: Los pacientes con Medicare Parte D que necesitan tanto sitagliptina como metformina tambien deben preguntarle a su prescriptor si el comprimido combinado ofrece alguna ventaja clinica sobre tomar sitagliptina generica (ya al Precio Maximo Justo de la IRA Ronda 1 de $113 desde enero de 2026) junto con metformina generica (menos de $15 por mes al por menor). Esta pagina cubre los precios de 2026 para Janumet de marca y sitagliptina/metformina generica por farmacia, el programa de asistencia al paciente Merck Helps con una tabla de elegibilidad de ingresos basada en el nivel federal de pobreza de 2026, detalles de cobertura de Medicare Parte D, y lo que los pacientes de Medicaid y con seguro comercial pueden esperar pagar.

note.en: Generic sitagliptin/metformin immediate-release tablets began entering US pharmacies in May 2026 under patent settlement agreements between Merck and multiple generic manufacturers. The primary composition patent on sitagliptin phosphate expires November 24, 2026; authorized generic launches began before that date under negotiated settlement terms. Generic Janumet XR (extended-release) is expected in July 2026 or later under separate settlement terms; the co-formulation patent for Janumet XR extends to January 2029. By late 2026, generic sitagliptin/metformin immediate-release is expected to be widely available, with retail prices falling to $60 to $120 per month as supply increases. Ask your pharmacist for AB-rated generic sitagliptin/metformin phosphate tablets to ensure pharmacy substitution for Janumet. Zituvimet (sitagliptin free base plus metformin, by Zydus) is a separate branded product and is not a pharmacy-substitutable AB-rated generic for Janumet.
note.es: Los comprimidos genericos de sitagliptina/metformina de liberacion inmediata comenzaron a entrar a las farmacias de EE.UU. en mayo de 2026 bajo acuerdos de resolucion de patentes entre Merck y multiples fabricantes de genericos. La patente de composicion principal sobre el fosfato de sitagliptina expira el 24 de noviembre de 2026; los lanzamientos de genericos autorizados comenzaron antes de esa fecha bajo terminos de acuerdos negociados. El Janumet XR generico (liberacion prolongada) se espera en julio de 2026 o despues bajo terminos de acuerdos separados. Pregunte a su farmaceutico por comprimidos genericos de fosfato de sitagliptina/metformina con clasificacion AB para garantizar la sustitucion en farmacia por Janumet.

paragraphs.en: Janumet is an oral combination tablet with a drug acquisition cost well under $10 per day at 2026 generic prices. When a patient is admitted to a hospital and their home diabetes regimen is continued, the hospital dispenses medications from its own pharmacy and bills at facility rates. Those rates layer drug acquisition cost with pharmacy staff time, dispensing systems, formulary management overhead, and general facility fees. An oral tablet that costs the hospital under $10 per day can appear as $150 to $700 on a facility bill for a week-long admission.
paragraphs.es: Janumet es un comprimido oral combinado con un costo de adquisicion de medicamento bien por debajo de $10 por dia a precios genericos de 2026. Cuando un paciente es ingresado en un hospital y su regimen de diabetes en casa se continua, el hospital dispensa los medicamentos de su propia farmacia y factura a tarifas de instalacion. Esas tarifas superponen el costo de adquisicion del medicamento con el tiempo del personal de farmacia, los sistemas de dispensacion, los gastos generales de gestion del formulario y las tarifas generales de la instalacion. Un comprimido oral que le cuesta al hospital menos de $10 por dia puede aparecer como $150 a $700 en una factura de instalacion por una hospitalizacion de una semana.

paragraphs.en: Janumet is a Part D drug, not a Part B drug. Medicare does not publish an ASP (Average Sales Price) for sitagliptin/metformin combinations and there is no J-code for this oral tablet. Outpatient coverage runs through Part D prescription drug plans, not Part B medical benefit. For inpatient stays, Medicare DRG bundled payments typically include drug costs; the hospital absorbs sitagliptin/metformin from the DRG rate. However, patients may still see a line item for Janumet on an itemized inpatient bill, which may represent a documentation charge rather than a separately billable drug. Request an itemized bill and verify that any sitagliptin/metformin charges fall within your actual admission dates and that the dispensed product matches your prescription.
paragraphs.es: Janumet es un medicamento Parte D, no un medicamento Parte B. Medicare no publica un ASP (Precio de Venta Promedio) para combinaciones de sitagliptina/metformina y no hay codigo J para este comprimido oral. La cobertura ambulatoria se ejecuta a traves de planes de medicamentos recetados Parte D, no del beneficio medico Parte B. Para estancias hospitalarias, los pagos agrupados DRG de Medicare tipicamente incluyen los costos de medicamentos.

paragraphs.en: Three structural factors drive the gap between what Janumet costs at a retail pharmacy and what appears on a hospital bill. First, hospitals purchase drugs at contract rates but are permitted to mark up for handling. Second, the DRG bundling does not prevent hospitals from listing individual drug line items on patient-facing bills, even if Medicare is absorbing those costs. Third, if a brand Janumet tablet was dispensed when a cheaper generic was available, ask the hospital pharmacy to confirm which product was actually dispensed and whether the generic would have been substituted under your plan's formulary. The CMS Hospital Price Transparency rule requires hospitals to publish standard charges for all drugs, so you can compare your bill against the hospital's published price file.
paragraphs.es: Tres factores estructurales impulsan la brecha entre lo que Janumet cuesta en una farmacia al por menor y lo que aparece en una factura hospitalaria. Primero, los hospitales compran medicamentos a tarifas de contrato pero estan autorizados a aplicar recargos por manejo. Segundo, el agrupamiento DRG no impide que los hospitales listen elementos de medicamentos individuales en las facturas para los pacientes. Tercero, si se dispenso un comprimido de Janumet de marca cuando habia disponible uno generico mas barato, pregunte a la farmacia del hospital que producto se dispenso realmente.

intro.en: Merck operates the Merck Helps patient assistance program for Janumet, which provides the medication free of charge to qualifying uninsured US residents. The standard income threshold is 400 percent of the federal poverty level, meaning a single person earning up to $63,840 in 2026 may qualify. Patients with any prescription insurance, including Medicare Part D, Medicaid, or private plans, do not qualify for Merck Helps for Janumet. Separately, the availability of generic sitagliptin/metformin at $110 to $160 per month as of May 2026 means many patients now have a low-cost pharmacy option even without a formal patient assistance program. A manufacturer coupon for Janumet is available for commercially insured patients, capping copays at $5 per prescription up to a maximum savings of $150 per prescription, but this coupon cannot be used with Medicare or Medicaid.
intro.es: Merck opera el programa de asistencia al paciente Merck Helps para Janumet, que proporciona el medicamento de forma gratuita a los residentes de EE.UU. sin seguro que califican. El umbral de ingresos estandar es del 400 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza, lo que significa que una sola persona que gana hasta $63,840 en 2026 puede calificar. Los pacientes con cualquier seguro de prescripcion, incluidos Medicare Parte D, Medicaid o planes privados, no califican para Merck Helps para Janumet. Por separado, la disponibilidad de sitagliptina/metformina generica a $110 a $160 por mes desde mayo de 2026 significa que muchos pacientes ahora tienen una opcion de farmacia de bajo costo incluso sin un programa formal de asistencia al paciente.

If you have government insurance, apply for the Merck Helps patient assistance program instead. Merck Helps uses 400% FPL as its income threshold. Apply by phone at (800) 727-5400 or online at merckhelps.com. The IRA Round 2 Maximum Fair Price of $80 per month for Janumet takes effect January 1, 2027 for Medicare Part D enrollees, replacing any coupon-based pricing for that population.

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Visit merckhelps.com/JANUMET or call (800) 727-5400 (Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 8 PM ET) to confirm current program eligibility and start the application.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Visite merckhelps.com/JANUMET o llame al (800) 727-5400 (lunes a viernes, 8 AM a 8 PM ET) para confirmar la elegibilidad actual del programa e iniciar la solicitud.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Download or request the patient application form. Complete the patient section in full, including household size, income information, and the reason you are requesting assistance.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Descargue o solicite el formulario de solicitud del paciente. Complete la seccion del paciente en su totalidad, incluyendo el tamano del hogar, la informacion de ingresos y el motivo por el que solicita asistencia.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Have your prescriber complete and sign the prescriber section, which includes the Janumet prescription and a statement that the drug is medically necessary for your condition.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Gather required documents: most recent federal tax return or 4 consecutive pay stubs (to verify income), proof of US residency, your Janumet prescription, and a signed statement confirming you have no prescription drug insurance coverage.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Reunir los documentos requeridos: declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente o 4 talones de pago consecutivos (para verificar ingresos), prueba de residencia en EE.UU., su receta de Janumet y una declaracion firmada que confirme que no tiene cobertura de seguro de medicamentos recetados.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: Submit the completed application and all supporting documents by fax, mail, or the online portal at merckhelps.com. Processing typically takes 7 to 14 business days.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Envie la solicitud completa y todos los documentos de respaldo por fax, correo o el portal en linea en merckhelps.com. El procesamiento generalmente toma de 7 a 14 dias habiles.

numberedSteps.en: Step 6: If approved, Merck ships free Janumet directly to your home or your prescriber's office. Approval covers up to one year and can be renewed annually by reapplying.

commonDenialReasons.es: El solicitante tiene cualquier seguro de medicamentos recetados, incluidos Medicare Parte D, Medicaid o cobertura privada

commonDenialReasons.en: Incomplete application or missing prescriber signature
commonDenialReasons.es: Solicitud incompleta o firma del prescriptor faltante

commonDenialReasons.en: Insufficient income documentation (tax return or pay stubs not provided or illegible)
commonDenialReasons.es: Documentacion de ingresos insuficiente (declaracion de impuestos o talones de pago no proporcionados o ilegibles)

commonDenialReasons.en: Applicant is not a US resident
commonDenialReasons.es: El solicitante no es residente de EE.UU.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurance plan. Federal law requires plans to provide written explanation of coverage denials with the specific reason code and appeal instructions.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su plan de seguro. La ley federal requiere que los planes proporcionen una explicacion escrita de las denegaciones de cobertura con el codigo de razon especifico y las instrucciones de apelacion.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal first-level appeal within 60 days of the denial notice. Ask your prescriber to submit a letter of medical necessity explaining why Janumet, rather than separate generic sitagliptin plus metformin, is clinically appropriate for your situation.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal de primer nivel dentro de los 60 dias del aviso de denegacion. Pida a su prescriptor que envie una carta de necesidad medica explicando por que Janumet, en lugar de sitagliptina generica separada mas metformina, es clinicamente apropiado para su situacion.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your prescriber to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director. Peer-to-peer calls often reverse denials that written appeals alone do not.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Pida a su prescriptor que solicite una revision par a par con el director medico del plan. Las llamadas de par a par a menudo revierten denegaciones que las apelaciones escritas por si solas no revierten.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the first-level appeal is denied, escalate to an external independent review. For Medicare Part D, contact 1-800-MEDICARE or your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP). For commercial plans, contact your state Department of Insurance.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si se deniega la apelacion de primer nivel, escale a una revision independiente externa. Para Medicare Parte D, comuniquese con 1-800-MEDICARE o su Programa de Asistencia de Seguro de Salud Estatal (SHIP). Para planes comerciales, comuniquese con el Departamento de Seguros de su estado.

stepTherapyOverride.en: If your plan requires step therapy, meaning you must first try separate generic sitagliptin plus generic metformin before covering the fixed-dose Janumet combination, ask your prescriber to file a step-therapy override. Grounds for override typically include prior treatment failure, drug intolerance, or documented clinical reason why the combination tablet is necessary for adherence. Many states have laws requiring plans to honor step-therapy overrides when a prescriber documents medical necessity.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada, es decir, que primero debe probar sitagliptina generica separada mas metformina generica antes de cubrir la combinacion de dosis fija Janumet, pida a su prescriptor que presente una dispensa de terapia escalonada. Los fundamentos para la dispensa tipicamente incluyen fracaso previo del tratamiento, intolerancia al medicamento o razon clinica documentada de por que el comprimido combinado es necesario para la adherencia.

papFallback.en: If insurance appeals fail and you are uninsured or lose coverage, apply for the Merck Helps patient assistance program. Qualifying uninsured patients with household income at or below 400% FPL can receive free Janumet. Call (800) 727-5400 or visit merckhelps.com to apply. Processing takes approximately 7 to 14 business days.
papFallback.es: Si las apelaciones de seguro fracasan y no tiene seguro o pierde la cobertura, solicite el programa de asistencia al paciente Merck Helps. Los pacientes sin seguro calificados con ingresos del hogar iguales o inferiores al 400% FPL pueden recibir Janumet gratis. Llame al (800) 727-5400 o visite merckhelps.com para solicitar.

genericAlternative.en: Generic alternative: AB-rated generic sitagliptin/metformin tablets launched May 2026 and are typically 70 to 80 percent cheaper than brand Janumet. If your plan covers brand Janumet on a restrictive tier, ask your prescriber whether prescribing separate generic sitagliptin (at the IRA $113/month Part D rate since January 2026) plus generic metformin (under $15/month) would be clinically equivalent and substantially cheaper for your 2026 coverage.
genericAlternative.es: Alternativa generica: los comprimidos genericos de sitagliptina/metformina con clasificacion AB lanzados en mayo de 2026 son tipicamente 70 a 80 por ciento mas baratos que el Janumet de marca. Si su plan cubre Janumet de marca en un nivel restrictivo, preguntele a su prescriptor si recetar sitagliptina generica separada (a la tarifa IRA de $113/mes de Parte D desde enero de 2026) mas metformina generica (menos de $15/mes) seria clinicamente equivalente y sustancialmente mas barato para su cobertura de 2026.

paragraphs.en: Janumet is a Medicare Part D drug. Coverage runs through Medicare prescription drug plans, not Medicare Part B medical benefit. As of January 1, 2026, Janumet does not yet have a drug-specific Monthly cap or IRA-negotiated Maximum Fair Price under Part D; those protections apply to Round 1 IRA drugs like Januvia, Jardiance, and Eliquis. The 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,000 does apply to Janumet: once you have paid $2,000 across all Part D drugs combined in a calendar year, your cost share drops to $0 for the rest of that year. At typical 2026 Part D copay rates for a mid-tier brand drug, the $2,000 annual cap may be reached in 10 to 14 months for patients using Janumet as their only expensive Part D drug.
paragraphs.es: Janumet es un medicamento Medicare Parte D. La cobertura se ejecuta a traves de los planes de medicamentos recetados de Medicare, no del beneficio medico Medicare Parte B. A partir del 1 de enero de 2026, Janumet aun no tiene un limite mensual especifico para el medicamento o un Precio Maximo Justo negociado por la IRA bajo Parte D; esas protecciones aplican a los medicamentos IRA Ronda 1 como Januvia, Jardiance y Eliquis. El limite anual de gastos de bolsillo de Parte D de 2026 de $2,000 si aplica a Janumet.

paragraphs.en: Beginning January 1, 2027, Medicare Part D enrollees will benefit from the IRA Round 2 Maximum Fair Price for Janumet. CMS negotiated this price at $80 per 30-day supply, down from the pre-negotiation list price of approximately $526 per month. That represents an 85 percent reduction and is the largest percentage cut among all 15 Round 2 negotiated drugs. No Medicare Part D plan will be permitted to charge an enrollee more than $80 for Janumet at an in-network pharmacy after January 1, 2027. Patients currently enrolled in Medicare Part D who are paying higher than generic-equivalent rates for Janumet in 2026 should review whether their plan's formulary tier for brand Janumet, or the availability of the generic sitagliptin/metformin combination, produces a lower 2026 out-of-pocket cost ahead of the 2027 MFP effective date.
paragraphs.es: A partir del 1 de enero de 2027, los inscritos en Medicare Parte D se beneficiaran del Precio Maximo Justo Round 2 IRA para Janumet. CMS negocio este precio en $80 por suministro de 30 dias, desde el precio de lista previo a la negociacion de aproximadamente $526 por mes. Eso representa una reduccion del 85 por ciento y es el mayor recorte porcentual entre los 15 medicamentos negociados en la Ronda 2. Ningun plan Medicare Parte D podra cobrar a un inscrito mas de $80 por Janumet en una farmacia de la red despues del 1 de enero de 2027.

paragraphs.en: Janumet does not qualify for the $35 per month insulin cap that applies to insulin products under the Inflation Reduction Act. The $35 insulin cap covers insulin products specifically. Janumet and its companion Januvia are DPP-4 inhibitors, not insulin, so they fall under the general Part D cost-sharing structure in 2026 and under the drug-specific IRA Maximum Fair Price in 2027 for Medicare beneficiaries. Prior authorization is standard for Janumet on most Medicare Part D and commercial formularies. Check your plan's prior authorization requirements before filling.
paragraphs.es: Janumet no califica para el limite de $35 por mes para insulina que aplica a los productos de insulina bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. El limite de $35 para insulina cubre especificamente los productos de insulina. Janumet y su companero Januvia son inhibidores DPP-4, no insulina, por lo que caen bajo la estructura general de participacion de costos de Parte D en 2026 y bajo el Precio Maximo Justo IRA especifico del medicamento en 2027 para los beneficiarios de Medicare.

intro.en: Janumet and generic sitagliptin/metformin are oral tablets with no HCPCS J-code and no Part B billing pathway. Still, several billing and insurance errors appear on claims and hospital bills for this drug class:
intro.es: Janumet y la sitagliptina/metformina generica son comprimidos orales sin codigo HCPCS J y sin ruta de facturacion Parte B. Sin embargo, varios errores de facturacion y seguro aparecen en reclamaciones y facturas hospitalarias para esta clase de medicamentos:

items.en: Brand Janumet billed when generic sitagliptin/metformin was dispensed: verify the dispensed drug name and NDC number on your itemized bill; the generic and brand carry different NDC codes and different prices
items.es: Janumet de marca facturado cuando se dispenso sitagliptina/metformina generica: verifique el nombre del medicamento dispensado y el numero NDC en su factura detallada; el generico y la marca tienen diferentes codigos NDC y diferentes precios

items.en: Charged at Janumet combination price when only separate sitagliptin or only metformin was dispensed: confirm the exact dispensed product against the prescription
items.es: Cobrado al precio de combinacion de Janumet cuando solo se dispenso sitagliptina separada o solo metformina: confirme el producto dispensado exacto contra la receta

items.en: Inpatient facility charge applied to medication the patient brought from home: hospitals cannot bill for drugs the patient self-supplied if those drugs were not dispensed from the hospital pharmacy
items.es: Cargo de instalacion hospitalaria aplicado a un medicamento que el paciente trajo de casa: los hospitales no pueden facturar por medicamentos que el paciente suministro si esos medicamentos no fueron dispensados desde la farmacia del hospital

items.en: Prior authorization denial not appealed: most Part D plans and commercial plans require prior authorization for Janumet; if your claim was rejected for missing PA, ask your prescriber's office to file the PA request before refilling
items.es: Denegacion de autorizacion previa no apelada: la mayoria de los planes Parte D y planes comerciales requieren autorizacion previa para Janumet; si su reclamacion fue rechazada por falta de AP, pida al consultorio de su prescriptor que presente la solicitud de AP antes de volver a surtir

items.en: IRA Round 2 MFP not honored after January 2027: Medicare Part D enrollees charged more than $80 for brand Janumet after January 1, 2027 should contact their plan's member services and request a coverage determination
items.es: MFP Round 2 IRA no respetado despues de enero de 2027: los inscritos en Medicare Parte D cobrados mas de $80 por Janumet de marca despues del 1 de enero de 2027 deben comunicarse con el servicio de miembros de su plan y solicitar una determinacion de cobertura

en.question: Is there a generic for Janumet in 2026?
en.answer: Yes, as of May 2026. Generic sitagliptin/metformin hydrochloride immediate-release tablets began entering US pharmacies in May 2026 under patent settlement agreements Merck reached with multiple generic manufacturers. These are AB-rated equivalents, meaning pharmacists can substitute them for brand Janumet. GoodRx prices for the generic start around $110 per month. Janumet XR (extended-release) generic is expected in July 2026 or later under separate settlement terms. Ask your pharmacist specifically for generic sitagliptin/metformin phosphate tablets to ensure substitution. Zituvimet (sitagliptin free base plus metformin, from Zydus) is a separate branded product and is not a pharmacy-substitutable generic for Janumet.

en.question: What is the IRA negotiated price for Janumet in 2027?
en.answer: Under the Inflation Reduction Act Round 2 Medicare drug price negotiations, CMS set a Maximum Fair Price of $80 per 30-day supply for Janumet, effective January 1, 2027. This represents an 85 percent reduction from the pre-negotiation list price of approximately $526 per month and is the deepest percentage cut among all 15 drugs in the Round 2 negotiation. No Medicare Part D plan may charge an enrollee more than $80 for brand Janumet at an in-network pharmacy after that date. For 2026, Medicare Part D enrollees pay their plan's standard formulary tier rate; the $80 Maximum Fair Price does not apply until January 1, 2027.

en.question: How do I apply for the Merck Helps patient assistance program for Janumet?
en.answer: Call (800) 727-5400 or visit merckhelps.com/JANUMET to start the Merck Helps application. You will need: your Janumet prescription, proof of US residency, documentation of household income (most recent tax return or 4 pay stubs), your prescriber's signed section of the application form, and a statement that you have no prescription drug insurance. For a single person in 2026, income must be at or below $63,840 (400 percent of FPL). Processing typically takes 7 to 14 business days. If approved, Merck ships Janumet free to your home or prescriber's office. Patients with any prescription insurance, including Medicare Part D or Medicaid, do not qualify.

en.question: Can I use the Janumet savings coupon with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law (42 U.S.C. § 1320a-7b) bars manufacturer copay coupons and savings cards from being used by anyone with Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA coverage. The Janumet Savings Coupon is for commercially insured patients only and reduces copays to as low as $5 per prescription, up to $150 savings per fill. If you have Medicare Part D, you cannot use the manufacturer coupon; instead, check your plan's formulary tier for Janumet or apply for the Merck Helps patient assistance program if you are below the income threshold.

en.question: What is the difference between Janumet, Januvia, and Janumet XR?
en.answer: Januvia contains sitagliptin alone (25 mg, 50 mg, or 100 mg tablets, taken once daily). Janumet combines sitagliptin with metformin HCl in one tablet, taken twice daily with meals; available as 50 mg/500 mg and 50 mg/1000 mg. Janumet XR combines the same ingredients in an extended-release form, taken once daily. All three are made by Merck. Under IRA Round 1, Januvia received a Maximum Fair Price of $113 per month effective January 2026. Under IRA Round 2, Janumet and Janumet XR received a Maximum Fair Price of $80 per month effective January 2027. Generic sitagliptin launched May 2026 for Januvia-equivalent products. Generic sitagliptin/metformin immediate-release launched May 2026 for Janumet-equivalent products.

en.question: What does Janumet cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance, brand Janumet (50 mg/500 mg or 50 mg/1000 mg, 60 tablets for a 30-day supply) costs approximately $527 at the list price in 2026. With a GoodRx coupon, cash prices at major chains run $336 to $359 per month. Generic sitagliptin/metformin, which launched in May 2026, costs approximately $110 at CVS and Walgreens with a GoodRx coupon, and as low as $110 to $160 across other chains. Costco's cash price for brand Janumet runs $380 to $420 per month. Walmart accepts GoodRx coupons and prices brand Janumet around $348 with a coupon.

en.question: Does Medicare Part D cover Janumet?
en.answer: Yes. Janumet is a Part D drug covered through Medicare prescription drug plans. In 2026, most Part D plans include Janumet on their formulary, typically on a higher cost-sharing tier with prior authorization required. The 2026 annual Part D out-of-pocket cap of $2,000 applies: once you spend $2,000 across all Part D drugs combined in a calendar year, your cost drops to $0 for the rest of the year. Starting January 1, 2027, the IRA Round 2 Maximum Fair Price of $80 per month takes effect, capping what any Medicare Part D plan may charge for brand Janumet. Janumet does not have the $35 per month insulin-specific cap that applies only to insulin products.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for Janumet?
en.answer: If your plan denies Janumet coverage, first request the written denial with the specific reason code. Common reasons include step therapy (requiring you to try separate generic sitagliptin plus generic metformin first) and prior authorization not filed. Ask your prescriber to file a prior authorization with supporting documentation of medical necessity. If that is denied, escalate to a formal appeal within 60 days and ask your prescriber for a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director. As a parallel option, the generic sitagliptin/metformin combination (available May 2026) is typically covered at a lower tier. If all else fails, the Merck Helps program can provide free Janumet for uninsured patients at or below 400 percent FPL.

es.question: Hay un generico para Janumet en 2026?
es.answer: Si, desde mayo de 2026. Los comprimidos genericos de sitagliptina/clorhidrato de metformina de liberacion inmediata comenzaron a entrar a las farmacias de EE.UU. en mayo de 2026 bajo acuerdos de resolucion de patentes que Merck alcanzo con multiples fabricantes de genericos. Estos son equivalentes con clasificacion AB, lo que significa que los farmaceuticos pueden sustituirlos por Janumet de marca. Los precios de GoodRx para el generico comienzan alrededor de $110 por mes. Se espera que el Janumet XR generico (liberacion prolongada) este disponible en julio de 2026 o despues bajo terminos de acuerdos separados.

es.question: Cual es el precio negociado IRA para Janumet en 2027?
es.answer: Bajo las negociaciones de precios de medicamentos Medicare de la Ronda 2 de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, CMS fijo un Precio Maximo Justo de $80 por suministro de 30 dias para Janumet, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2027. Esto representa una reduccion del 85 por ciento desde el precio de lista previo a la negociacion de aproximadamente $526 por mes y es el recorte porcentual mas profundo entre los 15 medicamentos de la negociacion Ronda 2. Para 2026, los inscritos en Medicare Parte D pagan la tarifa de nivel de formulario estandar de su plan; el Precio Maximo Justo de $80 no aplica hasta el 1 de enero de 2027.

es.question: Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente Merck Helps para Janumet?
es.answer: Llame al (800) 727-5400 o visite merckhelps.com/JANUMET para iniciar la solicitud de Merck Helps. Necesitara: su receta de Janumet, prueba de residencia en EE.UU., documentacion de ingresos del hogar (declaracion de impuestos mas reciente o 4 talones de pago), la seccion firmada de su prescriptor del formulario de solicitud y una declaracion de que no tiene seguro de medicamentos recetados. Para una sola persona en 2026, los ingresos deben ser iguales o inferiores a $63,840 (400 por ciento del FPL). El procesamiento tipicamente toma de 7 a 14 dias habiles.

es.question: Puedo usar el cupon de ahorro de Janumet con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. § 1320a-7b) prohibe el uso de cupones de copago y tarjetas de ahorro del fabricante por parte de cualquier persona con cobertura de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA. El Cupon de Ahorro de Janumet es solo para pacientes con seguro comercial y reduce los copagos a tan solo $5 por receta, hasta $150 de ahorro por surtido. Si tiene Medicare Parte D, no puede usar el cupon del fabricante; en su lugar, verifique el nivel del formulario de su plan para Janumet o solicite el programa de asistencia al paciente Merck Helps si esta por debajo del umbral de ingresos.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre Janumet, Januvia y Janumet XR?
es.answer: Januvia contiene sitagliptina sola (comprimidos de 25 mg, 50 mg o 100 mg, tomado una vez al dia). Janumet combina sitagliptina con clorhidrato de metformina en un comprimido, tomado dos veces al dia con las comidas. Janumet XR combina los mismos ingredientes en forma de liberacion prolongada, tomado una vez al dia. Todos son fabricados por Merck. Bajo la IRA Ronda 1, Januvia recibio un Precio Maximo Justo de $113 por mes efectivo enero 2026. Bajo la IRA Ronda 2, Janumet y Janumet XR recibieron un Precio Maximo Justo de $80 por mes efectivo enero 2027.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta Janumet sin seguro en el mostrador de la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro, la marca Janumet (50 mg/500 mg o 50 mg/1000 mg, 60 comprimidos por suministro de 30 dias) cuesta aproximadamente $527 al precio de lista en 2026. Con un cupon GoodRx, los precios en efectivo en las principales cadenas oscilan entre $336 y $359 por mes. La sitagliptina/metformina generica, que se lanzo en mayo de 2026, cuesta aproximadamente $110 en CVS y Walgreens con un cupon GoodRx.

es.question: Medicare Parte D cubre Janumet?
es.answer: Si. Janumet es un medicamento Parte D cubierto a traves de los planes de medicamentos recetados de Medicare. En 2026, la mayoria de los planes Parte D incluyen Janumet en su formulario, tipicamente en un nivel de mayor participacion de costos con autorizacion previa requerida. El limite anual de gastos de bolsillo de Parte D de 2026 de $2,000 aplica. A partir del 1 de enero de 2027, el Precio Maximo Justo Round 2 IRA de $80 por mes entra en vigor, limitando lo que cualquier plan Medicare Parte D puede cobrar por Janumet de marca.

es.question: Que pasa si mi seguro deniega la cobertura de Janumet?
es.answer: Si su plan deniega la cobertura de Janumet, primero solicite la denegacion por escrito con el codigo de razon especifico. Las razones comunes incluyen terapia escalonada (requiriendole que primero pruebe sitagliptina generica separada mas metformina generica) y autorizacion previa no presentada. Pida a su prescriptor que presente una autorizacion previa con documentacion de respaldo de necesidad medica. Si se deniega, escale a una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias. Como opcion paralela, la combinacion generica de sitagliptina/metformina disponible desde mayo de 2026 generalmente se cubre en un nivel mas bajo.
